scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "bun run dev:server" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n server,collab,web -c blue,magenta,green "bun run dev:server" "bun run dev:collab" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.build: bun run --filter server build && bun run --filter collab build && bun run --filter web build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter server typecheck && bun run --filter collab typecheck && bun run --filter web typecheck
